scope: Reading-page play clicks with normal scrolling; timed SVG scene geometry, pause/resume, seek from end and replay. Authored waits and equilibrium/boundary defaults are explicit, with a separate nonzero-input motion test. Static models are counted separately. This is playback QA, not all original-runtime input equivalence.
